newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on inside day, overbought.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on inside day, overbought.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a mild setback tied to signals the market was overbought after recent rallies that took prices to a series of contract highs, traders said.
"It was an inside day following Friday's runup," a trader said.
Rice rallied Friday as USDA estimated U.S. 1996-97 U.S. rice ending stocks at 25.3 million cwt, below the previous government outlook for 25.6 million.
"We're now at pretty lofty levels but there aren't a lot of offers over the market," the trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 250 contracts, below 1,386 traded Friday.
Rice futures closed unchanged to two cents per cwt lower, with January down 1/2 cent per cwt at $11.31-1/2.
